annotations.title: Dental cost in 2 to 5 US states side by side

description: Use this when the user names two to five US states and asks what one of the 12 procedures (exam and cleaning, filling, deep cleaning, extraction, root canal, crown, implant, All-on-4, dentures, braces, veneer, whitening) costs in each, or in which of them it costs less, for instance before a move or before travelling for care. Returns, for each state, the cash band (low / average / high) in US dollars with its basis badge (observed or estimated), its rank among the 51 state averages and its gap in percent to the national mean, plus the national band. Every row comes from the same series with its source and period (for crowns, the ASQ360/CareCredit Average Procedural Cost Study 2023-2024 state averages), so the states are lined up on one basis; cosmetic procedures carry no state variation. Phrasings: "line up implant costs in Texas, Florida and Arizona", "dentures in Ohio and Michigan side by side", "¿dónde sale más barato un implante, en Texas o en California?", "compara el costo de una corona en Nueva York y Nueva Jersey". Do not use for: diagnosis, treatment choice, a named insurer's plan price, dentist recommendations, countries other than the US and Canada. Observed market research with a source URL and period on every figure; not a quote, not medical advice.

procedure.description: Procedure id. One of: exam (Exam, cleaning & X-rays), filling (Composite filling (1 tooth)), deepclean (Deep cleaning (SRP, per quadrant)), extraction (Tooth extraction), rootcanal (Root canal), allon4 (All-on-4 (per arch)), whitening (Professional teeth whitening), crown (Dental crown), veneer (Porcelain veneer (per tooth)), braces (Braces (traditional, full case)), implant (Single dental implant (complete)), dentures (Full set of dentures (both arches)).
